title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
hook_text: TypeSafe hit seven point five billion.
script:
TypeSafe just hit a seven point five billion dollar valuation for its Jev system.
That massive milestone came just weeks after the non-text AI model launched.
TypeSafe also closed an eight hundred seventy million dollar funding round.
Large corporations are rushing to adopt it because Jev bypasses traditional text processing.
It operates significantly faster than standard language models while consuming far fewer tokens.
Would you trust a non-text model to handle your daily workload?
